title: SCA: Spatial Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning of GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GUI agents automate tasks on digital devices by grounding language instructions in visual interfaces. Existing group-relative reinforcement learning improves GUI action prediction by comparing the rewards of multiple responses sampled from the same GUI state. However, binary evaluation treats spatially different failed clicks as identical and provides no relative signal when all sampled clicks fail. To address these limitations, we propose Spatial Credit Assignment (SCA), which uses the screen coordinates of sampled clicks to refine group-relative credit. Specifically, SCA predicts each held-out response's reward from the other responses in groups containing both successes and failures, then uses the prediction residual to adjust credit. When all sampled clicks fail, SCA instead orders them by distance to the annotated target. These spatial references are used only to construct the training update; the deployed policy remains unchanged.

translated_title: SCA：面向GUI智能体强化学习的空间信用分配方法
translated_abstract: GUI智能体通过将语言指令落地到视觉界面上，实现数字设备上的任务自动化。现有的组相对强化学习通过比较从同一GUI状态采样的多个响应的奖励来改进GUI动作预测。然而，二元评估方式将空间上不同的失败点击视为等同，并且当所有采样点击全部失败时无法提供任何相对信号。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了空间信用分配（SCA），利用采样点击的屏幕坐标来细化组相对信用。具体而言，SCA在包含成功和失败的组中，根据其他响应预测每个留出响应的奖励，然后利用预测残差来调整信用。当所有采样点击均失败时，SCA则根据点击与标注目标的距离对它们进行排序。这些空间参考仅用于构建训练更新；部署的策略本身保持不变。
tldr: SCA利用点击的屏幕坐标为GUI智能体的组相对强化学习提供细粒度的空间信用分配，使得在全部采样点击失败的情况下也能通过距离排序产生有效的训练信号。
en_tdlr: SCA refines group-relative reinforcement learning for GUI agents by leveraging the screen coordinates of sampled clicks, providing meaningful training signals even when all sampled clicks fail through distance-based ordering.
